remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam at Amer. Place, April 1946 [note of backing inscription 4]. Similar to the small 'Shell and old Shingle' series. Leaf design left center." Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscription 1. Part of series renumbered by O'Keeffe and Doris Bry in 1970. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: An open, creamy white shell is visible at the bottom of this work. Behind it, a rippling, textured gray single stands on its side, propped against a white background. The objects rest on a flat black surface.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
